title: A Multi-Stage Text-to-SQL Framework using MSE-Extraction and Query Recall Optimization
description: A published research project focused on reliable, low-latency Text-to-SQL generation for relational databases.
highlights: Designed a multi-stage Text-to-SQL framework integrating MSE-extraction, multi-agent query generation, and recall-based optimization, achieving 89.3% exact-match accuracy and 92.1% execution accuracy on relational databases.
Implemented query recall optimization with similarity-based retrieval, reducing average query latency by 59.5% and improving robustness for real-time, domain-specific database querying.

title: Doc2GraphQA: Document to Knowledge Graph Question Answering System
description: A published research project for converting documents into knowledge graphs for interpretable question answering.
highlights: Designed a unified Doc2GraphQA framework that transforms multi-format documents into semantically enriched knowledge graphs, enabling multi-hop question answering, aggregation, and predictive reasoning using LLMs.

Built a hybrid symbolic-neural QA engine combining entity-relation extraction, graph embeddings, Cypher-based querying, and multi-agent LLM reasoning, supporting scalable and interpretable QA across fixed and open-schema documents.
